title: Billing Standard: Energy Lines by Structure and During Holdover - C&I
content:
*Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts: energy lines on the bill.*

1. C&I charges are billed only while the contract is active, termination pending, holdover or closed.
2. On a fixed structure, all of the cycle's kWh are billed on one energy charge line at the contract rate.
3. On a real-time index structure, all kWh are billed on one index energy charge line at the month's index price plus the contract rate.
4. On a block and index structure, any kWh above the block are billed on an index energy charge line at the month's index price with no adder, because the block price carries the margin; when usage is below the block, the whole block is still billed on the block energy charge line.
5. During holdover, all kWh are billed on an index energy charge line at the month's index price plus the holdover adder, except that the adder is not charged when the structure waives it for a late expiry notice and the expiry notice was missing or not compliant.
6. The month's index price is the monthly index price notice for the month of the billing period start.
7. Each energy amount is the kWh multiplied by the price in cents per kWh, divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent.

## Clause no longer in force

The clause that, on a block and index structure, the first block kWh per cycle are billed on a block energy charge line at the contract rate is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. Clause 4 above remains in force.

## Line construction

| Situation | Line | Price per kWh |
|---|---|---|
| fixed structure, in term | energy charge | contract rate |
| real-time index structure, in term | index energy charge | month's index price plus the contract rate |
| block and index structure, kWh above the block | index energy charge | month's index price, no adder |
| holdover, compliant expiry notice | index energy charge | month's index price plus the holdover adder |
| holdover, expiry notice missing or not compliant, waiver provided by the structure | index energy charge | month's index price |

## Worked amount (hypothetical)

412350 kWh at 7.125 cents per kWh: 412350 multiplied by 7.125 is 2937993.75; divided by 100 that is 29379.9375; rounded half up to the cent, the line is $29379.94.

## Status check

A contract in pending enrollment or rejected status carries no C&I charges.
